description: Ireland: State Pension (Non-Contributory) means test and 2026 weekly rate (EUR288 maximum, EUR2.50 less per EUR2.50 of means above EUR30, nil above EUR315; EUR10 more at 80). Capital counted in complete EUR1,000s (first EUR20,000 nil, next EUR10,000 at EUR1, next EUR10,000 at EUR2, rest EUR4 a week per EUR1,000); a couple each assessed on half the joint capital and half the joint income; EUR200 a week of employment pay ignored per partner. Also returns the savings limits and the 2027 maximum.
